主要内容: Levi's is using lasers to make jeans look distressed. The company has introduced a new technology called Project F.L.X. (future-led execution) to automate the process of distressing denim jeans. Previously, the process involved manual labor, harsh chemicals, and sanders, which took 20 to 30 minutes per pair of jeans. With laser finishing, the same result can be achieved in just 90 seconds. This new method is faster and more environmentally friendly, reducing the number of chemical formulations used from a few thousand to just a few dozen. Levi's aims to remove all hazardous chemicals from its manufacturing by 2020, and this innovation is a major step toward that goal.
